cases.name: Ana Piñon-Williams
cases.about: She was an employee at SunTrust Bank in Sebring, FL. Pinon-Williams’ brother-in-law, Tim Williams said she was a devout Christian who was “family to everyone she knew,” and just recently began as an employee of the SunTrust branch in Sebring. He said she quickly came to love her job and co-workers. Williams said his sister-in-law was a mother to seven children, “and family to everyone she knew.” He added that “loving came easy to her” and that “living without her will be hard.”

cases.name: Marisol Lopez
cases.about:
She was an employee at SunTrust Bank in Sebring, FL. The married mother of two was remembered by her former co-worker, Shelley Speight Lopez, for having a generous spirit.

“What always stood out about Marisol was her kindness, her giving heart, her sweet spirit, and her willingness to help everyone,” Lopez posted on Facebook. “She never complained, never lost her temper, and had a work ethic second to none! I remember nominating her for the Teller of the Year Award without her knowing.”

According to Florida Today, Lopez sang in the choir and taught Sunday school at the Spanish-speaking Nuevo Pacto Methodist church in Sebring.
